description: Sixteen buttons that drive whatever you map them to, standing in for a Kilpatrick Smasher USB controller

params.text: Press it to move the parameter mapped to it; hold M with the pointer over it to map it, and hold L to switch it between momentary and latching

notes: nothing happens until a control here is mapped: hold M with the pointer over it, then click the control in the patch it should drive
a button in latching mode has a red ring round it and stays on until it is pressed again; every button starts momentary
the hardware is chosen from the module's menu, and the choice is kept in the patch whether the hardware is plugged in or not, so a patch can be edited without it
clicking the panel away from a control blinks the USB lamp on the hardware, which is how you tell which of several units this module is driving
a Smasher Expander placed immediately to the right turns the sixteen buttons into gate outputs and a vMIDI output
menu: MIDI Driver - Smasher Module — a heading over the MIDI drivers on this machine
MIDI Devices - Slot 1 — a heading over the devices found on the chosen driver; only Smasher hardware is offered
Subscribe to Kilpatrick-Toolbox — opens the maker's other plugin on the VCV library, which holds modules for the vMIDI cables these expanders send
www.kilpatrickaudio.com — opens the maker's page for the hardware in a browser
